statements.impact_statement: CVE-2025-8177 is a buffer overflow in setrow() in tools/thumbnail.c of LibTIFF up to 4.7.0 (https://gitlab.com/libtiff/libtiff/-/issues/715; upstream fix https://gitlab.com/libtiff/libtiff/-/commit/e8de4dc1f923576dce9d625caeebd93f9db697e1; https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-8177). The vulnerable code is only in the thumbnail program. In LibTIFF 4.7.0, which this package builds, tools/Makefile.am lists thumbnail only under EXTRA_PROGRAMS and check_PROGRAMS (https://gitlab.com/libtiff/libtiff/-/blob/v4.7.0/tools/Makefile.am), so it is built for the test suite and never installed. Unpacked the currently published DHI tiff build for Debian 13, all ten binary packages for amd64 and arm64 (libtiff6, libtiffxx6, libtiff-dev, libtiff5-dev, libtiff-tools and libtiff-opengl, with the debug-symbol packages of the four that have them): libtiff-tools ships the thumbnail manual page but no thumbnail program, and none of the 86 ELF files contains the thumbnail program's usage text, while the other tools' usage text is found in their own binaries.
